test.create_query: CREATE TABLE rf_order_fact (cust UInt32, date UInt32, date_wide UInt64 CODEC(NONE), item UInt64 CODEC(NONE), val UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE rf_order_date (d_sk UInt32, d_month UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY d_sk
CREATE TABLE rf_order_customer (c_sk UInt32, c_half UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY c_sk
CREATE TABLE rf_order_item (i_sk UInt32, i_category UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY i_sk
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO rf_order_fact SELECT intHash32(number * 7 + 1) % 2000000, intHash32(number) % 2000, intHash32(number) % 2000, intDiv(number, 1000), number FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO rf_order_date SELECT number, intDiv(number, 60) FROM numbers(2000)
INSERT INTO rf_order_customer SELECT number, intHash32(number) % 2 FROM numbers(2000000)
INSERT INTO rf_order_item SELECT number, intHash32(number) % 303 FROM numbers(20000)
INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('rf_order_fact/{{_partition_id}}.parquet', Parquet) PARTITION BY intDiv(val, 500000) SELECT * FROM rf_order_fact ORDER BY val SETTINGS engine_file_truncate_on_insert = 1
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(val) FROM rf_order_fact AS f JOIN rf_order_customer AS c ON f.cust = c.c_sk JOIN rf_order_date AS d ON f.date_wide = d.d_sk WHERE c.c_half = 0 AND d.d_month = 16
SELECT count(), sum(val) FROM rf_order_fact AS f JOIN rf_order_date AS d ON f.date = d.d_sk JOIN rf_order_item AS i ON f.item = i.i_sk WHERE d.d_month = 16 AND i.i_category = 0
SELECT count(), sum(val) FROM rf_order_fact_parquet AS f JOIN rf_order_customer AS c ON f.cust = c.c_sk JOIN rf_order_date AS d ON f.date_wide = d.d_sk WHERE c.c_half = 0 AND d.d_month = 16
SELECT count(), sum(val) FROM rf_order_fact_parquet AS f JOIN rf_order_date AS d ON f.date = d.d_sk JOIN rf_order_item AS i ON f.item = i.i_sk WHERE d.d_month = 16 AND i.i_category = 0
